name: Hotel Robe
summary: Landscape, one continuous shot in a warm luxury hotel room. In an open satin robe, topless, with a lace thong and stockings, she walks toward the camera, plays with her hair, turns to show her back, reaches out to him and opens the robe wide.

start.composition: a wide photo at standing eye level, she stands a few steps away in the middle of the room facing the camera, her whole body in frame, smiling at him
start.outfit: an open champagne satin robe falling off her shoulders, topless, an ivory lace thong with a matching garter belt and sheer ivory stockings
start.setting: warm lamplight, in a luxury hotel suite with a made king bed, wood-panelled walls, a leather armchair and soft sconces

legs: she walks slowly toward the camera, smiling, the robe slipping off her shoulders
she lifts her hands and runs them through her hair, swaying her hips
she turns to look back over her shoulder at the camera, the robe sliding down her back
she turns back and reaches one hand out toward the camera, then leans forward with a smile
she takes the edges of the robe and opens it wide, holding eye contact
leg_suffix: handheld camera at standing eye level, gentle natural sway, continuous shot, no cuts, smooth natural motion
video_negative: camera cut, scene change, morphing, face change, extra fingers, distorted hands, flicker, different person
script:
[0-2s] Hello, darling.
[3-4s] Like what you see?
[4-11s] So good.
[11-13s] Your turn.
